f_H_conventions.finding: F23: the Cloud-9 `>= 100 cm^2/g` verdict depends on WHICH f_H is used. The two-component live path gives a pass; the deprecated 0.297 placeholder path gives an effective cross section far below the bar. conventions.note: the same model differs by a factor ~1.78 between the quantity the paper quotes as passing (canonical 166) and the quantity the joint fit grades (effective ~100); that factor dwarfs the 0.2% near-miss

verdict.against_published_posterior_peak_200: Q_total sits inside the published preferred region (peak ~200, broad intermediate range, both tails penalised); no published floor is crossed
verdict.honest_limit: this shows the model is consistent with the published Cloud-9 inference, not that Cloud-9 confirms the model: the published constraint is weak, prior-driven, and the profile alone does not discriminate CDM from SIDM
